en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing two substantial masonry school buildings in a sparsely developed landscape. Two men stand on open ground in the foreground. The main left building has the Swedish words "FOLKSKOLA" on its facade. Printed Swedish captions at the bottom identify the institutions and location, and stamped text reads "UDDEVALLA MUSEUM" with a printed date "Feb. 1903."
